part.text: Writing your scheduler utilities — implementing interval merging, free-slot search, and concurrency counting.

input.command:
python -c "
from scheduler import merge_intervals, find_free_slots, max_concurrent
assert merge_intervals([]) == []
assert merge_intervals([(1,3),(3,5)]) == [(1,5)]
assert merge_intervals([(1,4),(2,3)]) == [(1,4)]
assert merge_intervals([(5,7),(1,3),(2,4)]) == [(1,4),(5,7)]
orig=[(5,7),(1,3)]; merge_intervals(orig); assert orig==[(5,7),(1,3)], orig
try:
 merge_intervals([(3,3)]); assert False
except ValueError: pass
try:
 merge_intervals([(4,2)]); assert False
except ValueError: pass

assert find_free_slots([],0,60,30)==[(0,60)]
assert find_free_slots([],0,60,61)==[]
assert find_free_slots([(10,20),(30,40)],0,50,5)==[(0,10),(20,30),(40,50)]
assert find_free_slots([(10,20)],0,50,11)==[(20,50)]
assert find_free_slots([(-10,5),(45,100),(100,200)],0,50,1)==[(5,45)]
assert find_free_slots([(20,30),(10,25)],0,40,5)==[(0,10),(30,40)]
assert find_free_slots([(0,50)],0,50,0)==[]

assert max_concurrent([])==0
assert max_concurrent([(1,3),(3,5)])==1
assert max_concurrent([(1,4),(2,3)])==2
assert max_concurrent([(1,10),(2,5),(3,4)])==3
assert max_concurrent([(1,3),(2,4),(3,5)])==2
print('all ok')
"
